title: Celestin's illness and death, Pierson's management
summary: They discuss Celestin's stroke and heart trouble, his dislike of doctors, and French now leading the band.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Nobody knew that he had heart trouble, did they? Or did he?
Was it his heart or just started a stroke?

No he had a stroke, he had a stroke in his kidney, I guess after his kidney. That right to Eddie? That his heart went bad. Because he never did complain. Yeah I never knew he was sick or anything wrong with him at all. No, well he didn't like the doctor so that was some of the trouble. Maybe if he went to the doctor he might have lived a couple more years. More checkups. That's right. But Eddie was a fine manager. So I mean I've been having the band about two years now. But I've been doing pretty well with the band.
